track.title: Inglês Médico
track.description: Terminologia formal de documentação clínica em inglês, para profissionais de saúde.

PT.definition: Uma das duas câmaras superiores do coração, responsável por receber o sangue que retorna das veias.

EN.definition: One of the two upper chambers of the heart, which receive blood returning from the veins.
EN.usageNote: Plural: atria. Em laudos aparece sempre com o lado: left atrium, right atrium. Não confunda com atrial appendage (aurícula).

examples.sentence: The right atrium receives deoxygenated blood from the superior and inferior vena cava.
The echocardiogram showed a dilated left atrium.

PT.definition: Uma das duas câmaras inferiores do coração, responsável por bombear o sangue para as artérias.

EN.definition: One of the two lower chambers of the heart, which pump blood into the arteries.
EN.usageNote: Plural: ventricles. O adjetivo é ventricular (ventricular tachycardia). Também existem ventrículos no cérebro: lateral ventricle.

examples.sentence: The left ventricle ejects oxygenated blood into the aorta during systole.
Echocardiography demonstrated hypertrophy of the right ventricle.

PT.definition: Maior artéria do corpo, que conduz o sangue oxigenado do ventrículo esquerdo para a circulação sistêmica.

EN.definition: The largest artery in the body, carrying oxygenated blood from the left ventricle into the systemic circulation.
EN.usageNote: Plural: aortas ou aortae. Segmentos: ascending, descending e abdominal aorta. Adjetivo: aortic (aortic stenosis).

examples.sentence: A dissection of the ascending aorta was identified on contrast-enhanced CT.
An aneurysm of the abdominal aorta measuring 5.2 cm was noted.

PT.definition: Camada muscular média da parede do coração, responsável pela contração cardíaca.

EN.definition: The thick muscular middle layer of the heart wall, responsible for cardiac contraction.
EN.usageNote: Plural: myocardia. Adjetivo: myocardial. Em prontuário: viable myocardium (recuperável) e ischemic myocardium.

examples.sentence: Ischemia causes necrosis of the myocardium if blood flow is not restored.
Cardiac MRI revealed extensive scarring of the myocardium.

PT.definition: Saco membranoso de dupla camada que envolve o coração e a raiz dos grandes vasos.

EN.definition: The double-layered membranous sac that encloses the heart and the roots of the great vessels.
EN.usageNote: Plural: pericardia. Adjetivo: pericardial (pericardial effusion). Não confunda com epicardium, a camada interna do pericárdio.

examples.sentence: Echocardiography revealed a small effusion within the pericardium.
The surgeon opened the pericardium to relieve tamponade.

PT.definition: Estrutura que garante o fluxo sanguíneo unidirecional através das câmaras e vasos do coração.

EN.definition: A structure that ensures unidirectional blood flow through the chambers and vessels of the heart.
EN.usageNote: Em documentos, prefira o nome específico: mitral, aortic, tricuspid ou pulmonary valve. Heart valve é aceito ao falar com o paciente.

examples.sentence: The patient underwent replacement of a stenotic cardiac valve.
Transcatheter repair of the cardiac valve was completed without complications.

PT.definition: Necrose do tecido miocárdico causada por isquemia prolongada, geralmente por oclusão de uma artéria coronária.

EN.definition: Necrosis of myocardial tissue resulting from prolonged ischemia, typically due to occlusion of a coronary artery.
EN.usageNote: Abrevia-se MI. Variantes: STEMI e NSTEMI. Heart attack é coloquial; em documentos use myocardial infarction, quase sempre com acute.

examples.sentence: The ECG findings were consistent with acute myocardial infarction.
He was admitted with an ST-elevation myocardial infarction.

PT.definition: Alteração na frequência, no ritmo ou na condução dos impulsos elétricos do coração.

EN.definition: An abnormality in the rate, rhythm, or conduction of the heart's electrical impulses.
EN.usageNote: Plural: arrhythmias. Atenção à grafia: dois r e dois h. Existe também dysrhythmia, menos comum.

examples.sentence: The Holter monitor detected a sustained ventricular arrhythmia.
Cardiac arrhythmia was ruled out after 24 hours of monitoring.

PT.definition: Frequência cardíaca de repouso superior a 100 batimentos por minuto em adultos.

EN.definition: A resting heart rate exceeding 100 beats per minute in adults.
EN.usageNote: Em adultos: frequência acima de 100 bpm. Sempre qualifique: sinus, supraventricular ou ventricular tachycardia.

examples.sentence: The patient presented with sinus tachycardia at 120 beats per minute.
Supraventricular tachycardia resolved after adenosine administration.

PT.definition: Frequência cardíaca de repouso inferior a 60 batimentos por minuto em adultos.

EN.definition: A resting heart rate below 60 beats per minute in adults.
EN.usageNote: Em adultos: frequência abaixo de 60 bpm. Pode ser fisiológica em atletas; por isso symptomatic bradycardia é a expressão de alerta.

examples.sentence: Beta-blocker therapy may induce symptomatic bradycardia in elderly patients.
Sinus bradycardia was noted in the trained athlete and required no treatment.

PT.definition: Elevação sustentada da pressão arterial, definida por valores persistentemente acima dos limites de referência.

EN.definition: Sustained elevation of arterial blood pressure above the established reference thresholds.
EN.usageNote: Sem qualificador, refere-se à pressão arterial sistêmica. Existem também pulmonary hypertension e portal hypertension. O adjetivo é hypertensive.

examples.sentence: The patient has a history of poorly controlled hypertension.
Lifestyle changes are first-line management for mild hypertension.

PT.definition: Aumento anormal do tamanho do coração, geralmente identificado em exames de imagem.

EN.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the heart, typically identified on imaging studies.
EN.usageNote: É um achado de imagem, não um diagnóstico: descreve coração aumentado, em geral na radiografia (índice cardiotorácico acima de 0,5).

examples.sentence: Chest radiography demonstrated cardiomegaly with pulmonary congestion.
Mild cardiomegaly was noted on the admission chest X-ray.

PT.definition: Infecção do parênquima pulmonar, causada por bactérias, vírus ou fungos, com inflamação dos alvéolos.

EN.definition: An infection that inflames the air sacs of one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid or pus.
EN.usageNote: Qualifique a origem: community-acquired, hospital-acquired ou aspiration pneumonia. Em prontuário o diagnóstico é pneumonia; lung infection é linguagem leiga.

examples.sentence: Chest radiography revealed a right lower lobe pneumonia.
The patient was treated for community-acquired pneumonia with intravenous antibiotics.

PT.definition: Inflamação dos brônquios, que causa tosse, produção de muco e, às vezes, chiado.

EN.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the bronchial tubes, causing cough and mucus production.
EN.usageNote: Distinga acute bronchitis (em geral viral) de chronic bronchitis (tosse produtiva por pelo menos três meses em dois anos seguidos, parte da DPOC).

examples.sentence: Acute bronchitis is usually viral and does not require antibiotics.
He has a long-standing diagnosis of chronic bronchitis.

PT.definition: Doença inflamatória crônica das vias aéreas, com episódios recorrentes de chiado, falta de ar e tosse.

EN.definition: A chronic inflammatory disease of the airways causing recurrent wheezing, breathlessness and cough.
EN.usageNote: O th é mudo na pronúncia. Para crise, o termo de prontuário é asthma exacerbation; asthma attack é aceito, porém menos técnico.

examples.sentence: The child has well-controlled asthma on low-dose inhaled corticosteroids.
Spirometry confirmed reversible airflow obstruction consistent with asthma.

PT.definition: Sensação subjetiva de falta de ar ou de dificuldade para respirar.

EN.definition: Subjective difficulty or discomfort in breathing; shortness of breath.
EN.usageNote: No Reino Unido: dyspnoea. Em notas abrevia-se SOB (shortness of breath) e quantifica-se: dyspnea on exertion, at rest ou paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea.

examples.sentence: The patient reported progressive dyspnea on exertion over three weeks.
Acute dyspnea at rest prompted an urgent evaluation.

PT.definition: Obstrução de uma artéria pulmonar por um êmbolo, geralmente um coágulo originado nas veias profundas das pernas.

EN.definition: Blockage of a pulmonary artery, usually by a blood clot that has travelled from the deep veins of the legs.
EN.usageNote: Abrevia-se PE. Junto com DVT (deep vein thrombosis) forma o venous thromboembolism. O exame de confirmação é a CT pulmonary angiography.

examples.sentence: CT pulmonary angiography confirmed an acute pulmonary embolism.
Anticoagulation was started immediately for suspected pulmonary embolism.

PT.definition: Acúmulo anormal de líquido no espaço entre as pleuras que envolvem o pulmão.

EN.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid in the pleural space surrounding the lungs.
EN.usageNote: Descreva lado e volume: small right pleural effusion, bilateral pleural effusions. Distingue-se transudato de exsudato pelos critérios de Light.

examples.sentence: Ultrasound showed a moderate left pleural effusion.
Thoracentesis was performed to drain the pleural effusion.

PT.definition: Retirada de uma amostra de tecido ou de células para exame em laboratório.

EN.definition: The removal of a sample of tissue or cells for examination under a microscope.
EN.usageNote: Verbo: to biopsy; na voz passiva, the lesion was biopsied. Tipos: core needle, excisional, incisional e punch biopsy. O resultado vem no pathology report.

examples.sentence: A core needle biopsy of the breast mass was obtained under ultrasound guidance.
The biopsy confirmed adenocarcinoma.

PT.definition: Inserção de um tubo na traqueia, geralmente pela boca, para manter a via aérea e permitir ventilação mecânica.

EN.definition: Insertion of a tube into the trachea to secure the airway and allow mechanical ventilation.
EN.usageNote: Verbo: to intubate. Diz-se the patient was intubated. O oposto é extubation, a retirada do tubo.

examples.sentence: Rapid sequence intubation was performed due to respiratory failure.
Endotracheal intubation was uneventful.

PT.definition: Perda reversível da sensibilidade, com ou sem perda de consciência, induzida para a realização de procedimentos.

EN.definition: A reversible loss of sensation, with or without loss of consciousness, induced for medical procedures.
EN.usageNote: EUA: anesthesia; Reino Unido: anaesthesia. Tipos: general, regional (spinal, epidural) e local anesthesia. O profissional é o anesthesiologist.

examples.sentence: The procedure was performed under general anesthesia.
Local anesthesia with lidocaine was applied to the area.

PT.definition: Tubo fino e flexível inserido em um vaso, cavidade ou órgão para administrar líquidos ou drenar secreções.

EN.definition: A thin, flexible tube inserted into a vein, cavity or organ to deliver fluids or drain secretions.
EN.usageNote: Verbo: to catheterize. O procedimento chama-se catheterization (cardiac catheterization). Acesso periférico em notas: peripheral IV.

examples.sentence: A central venous catheter was placed in the right internal jugular vein.
The urinary catheter was removed on postoperative day two.

PT.definition: Fio cirúrgico, ou a técnica de fechamento de uma ferida ou incisão com ele.

EN.definition: A stitch or series of stitches used to close a wound or surgical incision.
EN.usageNote: Substantivo e verbo: to suture. Stitches é a forma coloquial. Em notas operatórias: the wound was closed with interrupted sutures.

examples.sentence: The laceration required a single interrupted suture.
Each layer was closed with a running suture.

PT.definition: Remoção cirúrgica de parte de um órgão ou de um tecido.

EN.definition: Surgical removal of part of an organ or tissue.
informalForms: cutting out part of an organ
EN.usageNote: Resection remove uma parte; excision remove uma lesão localizada; o sufixo -ectomy (appendectomy) remove o órgão inteiro. Verbo: to resect.

examples.sentence: The patient underwent a segmental resection of the sigmoid colon.
Negative resection margins were achieved.

PT.definition: Identificação da doença ou condição que explica os sinais e sintomas do paciente.

EN.definition: The identification of the disease or condition that explains a patient's signs and symptoms.
EN.usageNote: Plural: diagnoses (/-siːz/). Verbo: to diagnose; diz-se the patient was diagnosed with X. Em notas: working diagnosis (provisório) e final diagnosis.

examples.sentence: The working diagnosis was community-acquired pneumonia.
A delayed diagnosis worsened the outcome.

PT.definition: Lista de condições possíveis que podem explicar os sintomas, a serem distinguidas por exames.

EN.definition: A list of possible conditions that could explain a patient's symptoms, to be distinguished by further tests.
EN.usageNote: Abreviação: DDx. Em evoluções: The differential diagnosis includes… É uma lista de hipóteses, não uma conclusão.

examples.sentence: The differential diagnosis includes pulmonary embolism and pneumonia.
Laboratory tests helped narrow the differential diagnosis.

PT.definition: Previsão do curso provável e do desfecho de uma doença.

EN.definition: A prediction of the likely course and outcome of a disease.
EN.usageNote: Plural: prognoses. Qualifique: good, poor ou guarded prognosis. Guarded indica cautela diante de incerteza. Não confunda com diagnosis.

examples.sentence: Early detection is associated with an excellent prognosis.
The prognosis remains guarded given the extent of metastasis.

PT.definition: Causa ou conjunto de causas de uma doença.

EN.definition: The cause or set of causes of a disease or condition.
EN.usageNote: Reino Unido: aetiology. Aparece em of unknown etiology (causa desconhecida) e viral etiology.

examples.sentence: The cardiomyopathy was of ischemic etiology.
Fever of unknown etiology prompted further investigation.

PT.definition: Doença ou condição adicional que coexiste com a condição principal do paciente.

EN.definition: An additional disease or condition that coexists with a patient's primary condition.
EN.usageNote: Plural: comorbidities. Aparece em multiple comorbidities e significant comorbidity. Enfatiza o impacto no manejo; a lista de antecedentes é a past medical history.

examples.sentence: Surgery was deferred because of significant comorbidity.
Diabetes is a common comorbidity in patients with hypertension.

PT.definition: Condição que torna desaconselhável um tratamento ou procedimento por risco de dano ao paciente.

EN.definition: A condition that makes a particular treatment or procedure inadvisable because of the risk of harm.
EN.usageNote: Distinga absolute de relative contraindication. Fórmula típica: X is contraindicated in patients with Y. Não confunda com adverse effect.

examples.sentence: Active bleeding is an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation.
The patient has a relative contraindication to MRI because of a pacemaker.
